Jericho article treats its half as Riverside. News/listing usage: not found (search unavailable).
government_evidence: CDP, no government; a recognised village straddling the town line; the article mentions an 'Underhill Incorporated District' (a special district, not a general government) and a state-designated 'Riverside Village Center'.
reasoning: USPS tells people not to use the name and residents write Jericho or Underhill according to which side they live on, so a separate cell would rarely be matched. Straddle problem: the population-plurality town is Jericho, but the name, post office and identity point to Underhill, so folding the whole CDP into Jericho would mislabel it; each part should go to its own town.
